product_overview: TEST STORE is an APK distribution platform where users can discover, search, download, and review Android apps. Developers can publish and manage app listings, while admins approve submissions and manage platform accounts and settings.
core_goals: Discover and browse apps by featured lists, categories, search, and sorting.
View app details including screenshots, version history, ratings, reviews, and download options.
Register and log in as a user, developer, or admin to access role-based features.
Publish new APK apps and manage developer app listings and profile information.
Review app submissions, manage developers, and update site-wide settings as an admin.

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Create a new account as either a regular user or a developer using account details and password credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to /Test%20Store/auth/register.php -> Choose the user registration path -> Fill in username, email, password, and password confirmation -> Submit the registration form -> See the account created and proceed to the appropriate destination

Navigate to /Test%20Store/auth/register.php -> Choose the developer registration path -> Fill in username, email, password, password confirmation, developer type, country, and mobile number -> Submit the registration form -> See the account created and proceed to the developer destination
Navigate to /Test%20Store/auth/register.php -> Enter mismatched or invalid registration details -> Submit the registration form -> See validation errors

features.name: User Login
features.description: Sign in as a user or developer using email and password credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to /Test%20Store/auth/login.php -> Choose the user login path -> Fill in email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the home page
Navigate to /Test%20Store/auth/login.php -> Choose the developer login path -> Fill in email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the developer dashboard
Navigate to /Test%20Store/auth/login.php -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an authentication error

features.name: Admin Login
features.description: Sign in to the admin area using the admin account credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to /Test%20Store/admin/login.php -> Fill in the admin email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the admin dashboard
Navigate to /Test%20Store/admin/login.php -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an authentication error

features.name: App Discovery Home
features.description: Browse featured, newest, and top-rated apps from the home page, with category shortcuts and search access.
user_flows: Navigate to /Test%20Store/index.php -> View hero stats and app grids -> Open an app card -> See the app detail page
Navigate to /Test%20Store/index.php -> Choose a category shortcut -> See apps filtered by that category
Navigate to /Test%20Store/index.php -> Use the search bar -> See search results for the entered query

features.name: App Search & Filter
features.description: Search and browse the app catalog with keyword search, category filters, pricing filters, sorting, and pagination.
user_flows: Navigate to /Test%20Store/search.php -> Enter a search query -> Apply a category filter -> Choose a sort option -> See matching apps in the results list
Navigate to /Test%20Store/search.php -> Filter by free apps -> Review the updated results -> Open an app card -> See the app detail page
Navigate to /Test%20Store/search.php -> Filter by paid apps -> Change the category filter -> Navigate to the next page of results -> See more matching apps

features.name: Category Browsing
features.description: Browse approved apps within a selected category and sort the results.
user_flows: Navigate to /Test%20Store/category.php -> Select or open a category view -> Review the category-specific app list -> Open an app card -> See the app detail page
Navigate to /Test%20Store/category.php -> Change the sort order -> Review the updated app ordering -> Continue browsing the category list

features.name: App Detail Page
features.description: View complete app information, screenshots, descriptions, version history, reviews, similar apps, and download access.
user_flows: Navigate to /Test%20Store/app.php -> Review the app icon, name, developer, rating, downloads, size, and description -> Browse screenshots and version history -> Open the download flow -> Receive the APK download
Navigate to /Test%20Store/app.php -> Switch between the description, version history, and release notes sections -> Review the app’s full details
Navigate to /Test%20Store/app.php -> Scroll to the reviews section -> Read user reviews -> Open the reviews page for more feedback
Navigate to /Test%20Store/app.php -> Click a similar app -> See another app detail page

features.name: App Reviews
features.description: View all reviews for an app and submit a star rating with optional text feedback when logged in as a user.
user_flows: Navigate to /Test%20Store/review.php -> Review the paginated list of app reviews -> Move to another page of reviews -> Continue reading feedback

Navigate to /Test%20Store/app.php -> Open the review form while logged in as a user -> Select a star rating -> Enter a title and review text -> Submit the review -> See the review added to the app’s feedback
Navigate to /Test%20Store/app.php -> Open the review form without meeting the login requirement -> Attempt to submit feedback -> See that review submission is not available

features.name: APK Download
features.description: Download an app’s APK file from the app detail page.
user_flows: Navigate to /Test%20Store/app.php -> Choose to download the APK -> Receive the APK file download -> Continue browsing the store

features.name: Developer App Publishing
features.description: Publish a new app listing by entering app metadata and uploading the APK, icon, and screenshots for admin review.
user_flows: Navigate to /Test%20Store/developer/publish.php -> Fill in app name, package name, category, pricing type, version, descriptions, keywords, release notes, and technical details -> Upload the APK file, app icon, and screenshots -> Submit the app for review -> See the new app submitted with pending status
Navigate to /Test%20Store/developer/publish.php -> Enter invalid or incomplete app information -> Submit the form -> See validation errors
Navigate to /Test%20Store/developer/publish.php -> Upload supported media assets with the app details -> Submit for review -> See the submission accepted for moderation

features.name: Developer Analytics
features.description: View download trends, rating distribution, and per-app performance insights.
user_flows: Navigate to /Test%20Store/developer/analytics.php -> View the daily downloads chart -> Review the rating distribution chart -> Inspect the per-app breakdown table
Navigate to /Test%20Store/developer/analytics.php -> Compare app performance across the listed apps -> Review recent activity trends

features.name: Developer Dashboard and Profile Management
features.description: Track developer account activity, view app statistics, and update developer profile information.
user_flows: Navigate to /Test%20Store/developer/dashboard.php -> View app totals, download totals, average rating, and recent activity -> Open the publish or app management pages
Navigate to /Test%20Store/developer/profile.php -> Update profile information and upload a new profile photo -> Save the changes -> See the updated profile details
Navigate to /Test%20Store/developer/profile.php -> Change the account password -> Save the changes -> Continue using the updated account

features.name: Developer App Management
features.description: Review and manage the developer’s own apps from a consolidated list with status filters.
user_flows: Navigate to /Test%20Store/developer/my-apps.php -> Review the list of owned apps -> Filter by app status -> Open an app for editing
Navigate to /Test%20Store/developer/edit-app.php -> Update app metadata or files -> Save the changes -> See the revised app information

features.name: Admin App Approvals
features.description: Review pending app submissions and approve or reject them during moderation.
user_flows: Navigate to /Test%20Store/admin/app-approval.php -> Review the pending app list -> Open an app submission -> Inspect the app details, screenshots, and technical information -> Approve the app -> See the app marked as approved
Navigate to /Test%20Store/admin/app-approval.php -> Review the pending app list -> Open an app submission -> Enter a rejection reason -> Reject the app -> See the app marked as rejected

features.name: Admin Developer Management
features.description: Search, filter, block, unblock, and delete developer accounts from the admin area.
user_flows: Navigate to /Test%20Store/admin/developers.php -> Search for a developer by name or email -> Apply status or type filters -> Review the matching developer list
Navigate to /Test%20Store/admin/developers.php -> Select a developer -> Block the account -> See the developer status change to blocked
Navigate to /Test%20Store/admin/developers.php -> Select a blocked developer -> Unblock the account -> See the developer status change to active
Navigate to /Test%20Store/admin/developers.php -> Select a developer -> Delete the account -> See the developer removed from the list

features.name: Admin Site Settings
features.description: Edit site-wide configuration values that affect the public store experience.
user_flows: Navigate to /Test%20Store/admin/settings.php -> Review the current site settings -> Update one or more setting values -> Save the changes -> See the updated configuration reflected in the store

routes.description: Home page with featured, newest, and top-rated apps
Search and browse all apps with filters
Apps filtered by category
App detail page with download, reviews, and screenshots
All reviews for a specific app with pagination
APK file download handler (streams APK binary)
Unified login page for users and developers
Registration page for users and developers
Logout handler that clears session and redirects to login
Developer dashboard with stats, recent apps, and activity feed
Publish a new APK app with icon and screenshots
Edit an existing app's metadata and files
List of developer's own apps with status filters
Downloads and rating charts plus per-app stats
Developer profile editing with photo upload and password change
Admin-only login page
Admin dashboard with platform stats and pending approvals
Review and approve or reject pending app submissions
Browse and manage all apps in the store
List and manage developers (block/unblock/delete)
Edit site-wide settings like site name, allow_registration, etc.

Click Sign In button
Toggle password visibility with eye icon

features.name: Admin Login

Click Admin Sign In button
See error on invalid credentials
Redirected to admin dashboard on success

features.name: App Discovery Home

Search from hero search bar
Click category pills to filter by category
View Most Downloaded apps grid
